signal: Possible dropped item in a public area
implementation_boundary: An item drop does not establish deliberate littering.

signal: Paper passing or unusual movement during an exam
implementation_boundary: Only an invigilator can determine whether exam rules were broken.

signal: Possible cigarette or vape object and hand movement
implementation_boundary: Small objects and gestures are ambiguous. No camera inside toilets.

signal: Presence outside class during a configured lesson period
implementation_boundary: Check timetable, permission and context before alleging absence.

signal: Possible item removal requiring an ownership check
implementation_boundary: Permission and ownership cannot be determined by video alone.

signal: Possible forceful contact with school property
implementation_boundary: Inspect damage and legitimate activity before confirmation.

signal: Possible shoving, surrounding or cornering
implementation_boundary: No emotion inference, aggressor identification or victim label from video. Staff assess context.

signal: Possible hitting or forceful physical contact
implementation_boundary: Sport and play can look similar. Review urgently without automatic punishment.

signal: Repeated forceful movements or threatening gestures
implementation_boundary: Video cannot establish intent. Request human review.

signal: Covered lens, moved view or interrupted camera signal
implementation_boundary: Maintenance, lighting and network failure can trigger this signal.

signal: Estimated count exceeds a configured zone threshold
implementation_boundary: Threshold is a review trigger, not certified capacity.

signal: Entry count minus exit count exceeds a review tolerance
implementation_boundary: Missed crossings and occlusion require a physical check; no proof anyone remains inside.

signal: Anonymous presence persists beyond the zone timer
implementation_boundary: Waiting or legitimate activity may explain a long dwell.

signal: Staff-reviewed uniform context for an existing incident
implementation_boundary: Context only; no standalone compliance alert. Allow unknown and approved exceptions.

signal: Staff-confirmed student, teacher, visitor or unknown role
implementation_boundary: No gender inference from appearance. The matrix gender request is not automated; role remains unknown until staff confirm.

signal: Possible knife, blunt weapon or firearm-shaped object
review_route: School duty lead → authorised emergency route
implementation_boundary: A visual candidate is not proof of a weapon. Inert blade sample does not validate firearm detection.

signal: Possible sudden fall or person lying motionless
review_route: School admin, Duty teacher / first-aid team
implementation_boundary: This is a welfare alert, not a diagnosis; no health workspace is introduced.

signal: Person or vehicle crosses a restricted boundary or time window
implementation_boundary: Check permits and authorised activities. No biometric identification.

signal: Possible visible smoke or flames
review_route: School duty lead → authorised fire response
implementation_boundary: Video complements certified alarms; smoke and steam can be confused.

signal: Item remains unattended beyond a configured timer
implementation_boundary: An unattended item is not automatically dangerous.

signal: Possible climbing movement at a boundary
implementation_boundary: Inspect camera perspective and authorised maintenance.

signal: Vehicle remains at a gate beyond a configured dwell limit
implementation_boundary: Permission cannot be inferred without the authorised vehicle register.
